answer: Weight comes only from a trust graph where each vouch is a thread between two agents. Each epoch, 20 seed agents launch 10-hop random walks; an agent counts only if walks reach it. A sybil grove links to honest agents through a few bridge vouches, so walks rarely enter it: each bridge admits at most ~10 sybils, so 1,000 or 100,000 fakes still yield ~30 with 3 bridges. Weakness: bribing honest agents to vouch. Fix: vouchers post a bond, slashed when walk audits flag their vouchee's region, so each bribed bridge costs the attacker a full bond for only ~10 fakes.
